Medium Mode has the first challenging combos for people that already master the basics of flipping. In this difficulty you’ll find creative combos and the first double flips.

Good luck and play safe!

Clicking on the ‘Fail’ button will automatically add a letter of the word ‘FLIP’ to your name. After all players have clicked on the ‘success’ or ‘fail’ button, the game will continue to the next round. Once the full word ‘FLIP’ is reached for one or multiple players, the game is over.
